name: Montserrat
prevalence_note: No Montserrat police scam bulletin was found; the ECCB's warning to ECCU residents, Montserrat included, about prize and investment frauds is the main official reference.
cross_border_note: Montserrat (+1-664) shares the NANP, so calls from other Eastern Caribbean islands or North America can look local.

scams.name: ECCB-flagged prize or investment offer
scams.name_en: Prize or investment pitch reaching Montserrat residents as flagged by the ECCB
scams.signals_en: Someone pitches a prize or a fast-return investment to a Montserratian and asks for an upfront transfer.
scams.legit_en: The ECCB advises verifying any offer with licensed institutions and never paying fees in advance.
bait_tactics: Ask which ECCU regulator licensed them and ask for it in writing
Say any money matter goes through the bank branch in Brades
